speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following a recent course of antibiotics for acute sinusitis; to understand what is happening, have you noticed any changes in your urine color, frequency, or the presence of blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed increased thirst, frequent urination, or pain when you urinate? Also, please tell me if you have experienced any nausea, vomiting, or visible blood in your urine.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. The combination of fever, flank pain, and fatigue following antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, particularly with the reported skin rash indicating a potential allergic reaction to beta-lactams, strongly suggests a urinary tract infection that progressed to kidney infection. I am requesting a Urinalysis and Urine Culture to confirm the presence of bacteria and white blood cells.
